name: Drush Firewall
description: Environment-based protection that blocks or restricts Drush commands per environment, on production targets, or during maintenance mode.
project_description: Drush Firewall is a defensive operations guardrail that prevents unwanted Drush commands from running in the wrong environment or at the wrong time. It provides three independent policies, all configured entirely through settings.php (no admin UI, no config entities, no permissions): a hard blocklist that never runs given commands in this environment, a production blocklist that denies destructive commands when the Drush target alias name contains "prod", and a maintenance-mode allowlist that denies everything except an approved (and a small built-in essential) set while the site is in maintenance mode (useful during deploys, since core cron and other commands can still fire otherwise). Policies are enforced by a Drush pre-command hook on bootstrapped commands, with a separate no-bootstrap command file that must be registered in drush.yml to also protect commands such as sql:sync that do not bootstrap Drupal. A --disable-firewall flag bypasses all checks for a single run.
